rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking carefully about something or reflecting on it.

example.english: I took time to meditate on it before deciding whether to buy it.
example.traditional: 我諗咗好耐，先至決定買唔買。
example.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6 maai5 m4 maai5

rows.note: Use this for the deeper, more absorbed slice of contemplating or pondering something.

example.english: They meditate by the window, completely unaware of the time.
example.traditional: 佢坐喺窗邊沉思，完全冇留意時間。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zo6 hai2 coeng1 bin1 cam4 si1 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 lau4 ji3 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this when reflecting critically on one's own actions, decisions, or experience.

example.english: We need to meditate on why we failed this time.
example.traditional: 我哋要反思今次點解會失敗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faan2 si1 gam1 ci3 dim2 gaai2 wui5 sat1 baai6
